claims.sentence: The inclusion criteria were as follows: (1) Patients were 18 years old or older. (2) Patients had primary active cancer [ 15 ] with definite pathological diagnosis and objectively confirmed diagnosis of acute cancer-associated VTE, by means of compression ultrasonography (CUS) on lower extremities, computed tomography pulmonary angiography (CTPA), and planar ventilation/perfusion (V/Q) scan. [ 16 ] (3) Patients underwent a standard treatment of conventional direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs) which included rivaroxaban, edoxaban, and dabigatran for at least 6 months after the diagnosis of cancer-associated VTE, [ 16 - 18 ] with or without taking low-dose aspirin, and underwent routine VTE follow-up once every 3 to 6 months in principle according to the guidelines, [ 2 - 6 , 19 ] at the discretion of their attending physicians. (4) Patients received appropriate anticancer treatment in line with the recommendation from the Chinese Society of Clinical Oncology (CSCO), at the discretion of their attending oncologists.
